title: Jig lens
description: What the agent did and what it cost, from jig-core's records. This page runs only the queries below.

cost_per_day.title: Cost per day
cost_per_day.description: Model turns and what they cost, by UTC day, newest first.
cost_per_day.sql:
SELECT date(time, 'unixepoch') AS day, round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost, count(*) AS turns
FROM turn
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC

cost_per_model.title: Cost per model
cost_per_model.description: Cache hit is the share of prompt tokens that were read from the cache.
cost_per_model.sql:
SELECT model,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       count(*) AS turns,
       sum(input) AS input,
       sum(output) AS output,
       sum(cacheRead) AS cache_read,
       sum(cacheWrite) AS cache_write,
       round(100.0 * sum(cacheRead) / nullif(sum(input) + sum(cacheRead) + sum(cacheWrite), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_percent
FROM turn
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY cost DESC, model

cost_per_agent_role.title: Cost per agent role
cost_per_agent_role.description: The main agent is main; a child agent has the role it was started with, such as a reviewer.
cost_per_agent_role.sql:
SELECT agentRole AS role,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       count(*) AS turns,
       count(DISTINCT session) AS sessions
FROM turn
GROUP BY agentRole
ORDER BY cost DESC, role

cost_per_ticket.title: Cost per ticket
cost_per_ticket.sql:
SELECT coalesce(ticket, '(none)') AS ticket,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       count(DISTINCT session) AS sessions,
       count(*) AS turns
FROM turn
GROUP BY ticket
ORDER BY cost DESC, ticket

sessions_by_cost.title: Sessions, by cost
sessions_by_cost.description: Copy a session id into Session timeline to see every call and turn in it.
sessions_by_cost.sql:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT session, agentRole, ticket, time, cost, 0 AS calls, 0 AS errors FROM turn
    UNION ALL
    SELECT session, agentRole, ticket, time, 0.0, 1, outcome = 'error' FROM call
)
SELECT session,
       min(agentRole) AS role,
       max(ticket) AS ticket,
       datetime(min(time), 'unixepoch') AS started,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       sum(calls) AS calls,
       sum(errors) AS errors
FROM events
GROUP BY session
ORDER BY sum(cost) DESC, session
LIMIT 100

session_timeline.title: Session timeline
session_timeline.description: Every call and model turn of one session, in order. Give the session id.
session_timeline.sql:
SELECT datetime(time, 'unixepoch') AS time,
       'call' AS kind,
       tool || coalesce(' ' || action, '') AS what,
       environment,
       decision,
       decisionSource AS decided_by,
       answer,
       outcome,
       errorKind,
       durationMs AS duration_ms,
       waitedMs AS waited_ms,
       NULL AS cost,
       error
FROM call
WHERE session = :session
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime(time, 'unixepoch'),
       'turn',
       model,
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       cost,
       NULL
FROM turn
WHERE session = :session
ORDER BY time, kind

calls_per_day.title: Calls per day
calls_per_day.description: Errors ran and failed or never ran; blocked calls were refused by a rule or declined by you.
calls_per_day.sql:
SELECT date(time, 'unixepoch') AS day,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(outcome = 'error') AS errors,
       sum(outcome = 'blocked') AS blocked
FROM call
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC

calls_per_tool.title: Calls and failures per tool
calls_per_tool.sql:
SELECT tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       count(*) AS calls,
       sum(outcome = 'error') AS errors,
       sum(outcome = 'blocked') AS blocked,
       round(100.0 * sum(outcome = 'error') / count(*), 1) AS error_percent
FROM call
GROUP BY tool, action
ORDER BY errors DESC, calls DESC, tool, action

failures_per_error_kind.title: Failures per error kind
failures_per_error_kind.description: Why calls did not succeed: denied, no-screen, declined, invalid, dismissed, internal, tool, withheld, not-run.
failures_per_error_kind.sql:
SELECT errorKind, count(*) AS calls
FROM call
WHERE errorKind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY errorKind
ORDER BY calls DESC, errorKind

slowest_tools.title: Slowest tools
slowest_tools.description: By average time the tool ran, in milliseconds.
slowest_tools.sql:
SELECT tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       count(*) AS calls,
       round(avg(durationMs)) AS average_ms,
       max(durationMs) AS slowest_ms
FROM call
WHERE durationMs IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tool, action
ORDER BY avg(durationMs) DESC, tool, action
LIMIT 15

refused_calls.title: Calls refused by a rule
refused_calls.sql:
SELECT datetime(time, 'unixepoch') AS time,
       session,
       tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       environment,
       decisionSource AS decided_by,
       error
FROM call
WHERE decision = 'deny'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 100

questions_per_tool.title: Questions per tool
questions_per_tool.description: Each question is a call that asked you. Waits are in milliseconds.
questions_per_tool.sql:
SELECT tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       count(*) AS questions,
       sum(answer = 'allow') AS allowed,
       sum(answer = 'allow-session') AS allowed_for_the_session,
       sum(answer = 'decline') AS declined,
       sum(waitedMs) AS waited_ms,
       round(avg(waitedMs)) AS average_wait_ms
FROM call
WHERE answer IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tool, action
ORDER BY questions DESC, tool, action

questions_per_ticket.title: Questions per ticket
questions_per_ticket.description: A ticket is one change, so this is how often each change needed you.
questions_per_ticket.sql:
SELECT coalesce(ticket, '(none)') AS ticket,
       count(*) AS questions,
       sum(waitedMs) AS waited_ms
FROM call
WHERE answer IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ticket
ORDER BY questions DESC, ticket

longest_waits.title: Longest waits
longest_waits.description: The calls that waited longest for your answer, in milliseconds.
longest_waits.sql:
SELECT datetime(time, 'unixepoch') AS time,
       session,
       tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       approval AS asked_with,
       answer,
       waitedMs AS waited_ms
FROM call
WHERE answer IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY waitedMs DESC, time
LIMIT 50

calls_with_facts.title: Calls with facts
calls_with_facts.description: Newest first. passed, failed and conclusion are read from the facts; facts is all of them.
calls_with_facts.sql:
SELECT datetime(time, 'unixepoch') AS time,
       session,
       tool,
       coalesce(action, '') AS action,
       outcome,
       durationMs AS duration_ms,
       json_extract(facts, '$.passed') AS passed,
       json_extract(facts, '$.failed') AS failed,
       json_extract(facts, '$.conclusion') AS conclusion,
       facts
FROM call
WHERE facts IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200
